# AERIS MUSIC

> Original, pre-cleared production music. Every track is composed and mastered in-house from
> synthesis — no samples, no third-party content, so there is nothing for Content ID to match.
> Buyers receive the mastered file and a license certificate immediately on payment, with no human
> in the loop.

AERIS MUSIC licenses instrumental music to video creators, podcasters, and advertising producers.
Three tiers cover the common cases: $9 Basic for one project with unlimited views, $29 Premium for
multiple projects and monetized channels, $149 Sync for broadcast, film, and paid advertising.
Payment is by card (Stripe) or USDC on Base (x402), and delivery happens in the same response that
settles payment.

Thirteen tracks are also released under CC0 into the public domain with no attribution requirement, for
anyone who needs a bed track without a signup.

## Catalog

- [All tracks and licensing](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/): 15 mastered tracks with mood, tempo, key, and duration, and per-tier checkout for each.
- [Machine-readable catalog](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/agents/catalog.json): JSON with prices and USDC checkout URLs, for agents buying without a human.
- [Buying as an agent](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/agents/): how the x402 flow works, and what the settled response contains.
- [Free CC0 tracks](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/free/): thirteen instrumental tracks, public domain, no attribution.
- [CC0 repository](https://github.com/farmmer938-lgtm/aeris-cc0-music): the same thirteen tracks as raw downloads.
- [Support](https://farmmer938-lgtm.github.io/aeris-store/support.html): buy a license, tip in USDC on Base, or sponsor.

## Pricing

| Tier | Price | Rights granted |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | $9 | One project, unlimited views. YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, podcasts, personal projects. |
| Premium | $29 | Multiple projects, monetized channels, single-client commercial work. |
| Sync | $149 | Broadcast, TV, film, paid advertising, theatrical, worldwide. |
| Custom brief | $15 in USDC | A track written to a described brief, delivered within 48 hours. |
| Full commission | $249 | Original composition to brief, with revisions and a signed license. |

## Notes

- Rights are granted per track and per tier, and the certificate names both.
- The license is issued at the moment of payment; there is no approval step.
- Affiliates earn 20% of gross on their own per-tier links, paid in USDC from confirmed payments only.
- If a buyer needs a specific mood, length, and intended use, we quote a turnaround before any
  payment is made.
- Current verified revenue is $0.00. This file states that rather than implying otherwise.
